title: Retrograde Planets and Gemstones
sub: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 5 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. What a retrograde (vakri) planet actually is, why he says to fit its gemstone, leftover-food vibration, spouse gift rules and planet maturity ages.
desc: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 5, Retrograde Planet (वक्री गृह) by Brajesh Gautam: what vakri really means, his gemstone rules, jhoota and vibration, spouse gift cautions by house, and a remedy cheat sheet, with video timestamps.
points: Dwelling on someone else's pace can hand power to your own natal retrograde planet.
It only looks that way next to something moving faster, like a slower walker in a park.
A retrograde planet needs its own stone.
His universal law: fit a clean, well-matched gemstone for whichever planet is retrograde at birth.
The stone filters, it does not boost.
A gem never raises or lowers a planet's power, it only strains how much of it reaches you.
Leftover food, drink or clothing is said to carry another person's planetary vibration.
Gifts can switch a house's dosha on.
What you hand your spouse, by colour and item, is read against the sign sitting in the 7th house.
Each planet matures at its own age.
Moon at 5 through Ketu at 48; a retrograde dosha is said to start biting only after that age.
puts: • The stone is a filter, not a booster.
